title: What they say after a fight
hook: The quiet bit is the loudest.
items: It's not fine. I'm too tired to say why right now.
I'm not ready to say sorry. I'm still hurt too.
Can we not do this now?
I'm flooded. Come back to this in an hour.
I don't feel heard, so I've stopped trying.
I still love you. I just can't talk yet.
